description: This PHP file defines the 'JobTitle' entity class for a Human Resource Management system. It utilizes Doctrine ORM annotations to map the class to the 'ohrm_job_title' database table. The class encapsulates properties related to job titles, such as ID, name, description, notes, deletion status, and associations with other entities like 'Employee' and 'JobSpecificationAttachment'. It also includes getter and setter methods for these properties.

classes.name: JobTitle
classes.description: Entity class representing a job title with ORM mapping annotations, relationships to employees and attachments, and relevant properties.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Returns the ID of the job title.

methods.name: setId
methods.description: Sets the ID of the job title.

methods.name: getJobTitleName
methods.description: Retrieves the name of the job title.

methods.name: setJobTitleName
methods.description: Sets the name of the job title.

methods.name: getJobDescription
methods.description: Retrieves the description of the job role.

methods.name: setJobDescription
methods.description: Sets the description for the job role.

methods.name: getNote
methods.description: Retrieves the note associated with the job title.

methods.name: setNote
methods.description: Sets the note associated with the job title.

methods.name: isDeleted
methods.description: Checks if the job title is marked as deleted.

methods.name: setIsDeleted
methods.description: Marks the job title as deleted or active.

methods.name: getJobSpecificationAttachment
methods.description: Gets the associated job specification attachment.

methods.name: setJobSpecificationAttachment
methods.description: Associates a job specification attachment with this job title.
